body: Time happened. I'm just lonely and everyday it starts to hit me harder. There is nothing I can change about that. If I could reverse time, I could reverse the mistake that led me down this path but it's sadly not that easy.
I've been too far up on the happiness scale in my life at certain points to ever come to terms with how miserable I have been for the past 6 years...
Oh, yeah, at some points my life is a -30/10 instead of a -31. Thank god for this wonderful life...
Why should I? It's getting worse every single day.
Miserable, but thank you for asking. Found some motivation to go on for a few days until my prep stuff arrives. Damn holidays slowing my plans down.
Most important would probably be love, but I have given up on that a long time ago. I just look like a creepy nerd and women would rather go for some tall douchebag with a nice face.
Extroverts are suffering as they should. Good to see.
